scenes.narration: Duolingo is free. So how did it make more than a billion dollars?
It also passed 50 million daily active users, and it is the top-grossing education app on both major app stores.
In 2026, it is focusing on the free experience and new subjects like chess, math and music.
Its goal is 100 million daily users.
